calls.price_at_call: not stated (trading ~33x vs ~31x normal P/E; FastGraphs implies ~30-40% upside)
calls.thesis: First tracked Mark Roussin call on Vertiv: one of three AI dip-buys he is already buying - Vertiv supplies the power, thermal management and liquid cooling AI data centres need, so it wins whoever wins the chip race. Earnings expected +36% next year and +27% the year after (PEG below 1); financial health score ~80, net debt/EBITDA 0.2.
calls.bear_case: Not immune to an AI slowdown: if big tech cuts capex or delays data-centre projects, growth suffers.

calls.thesis: Vertiv: signal ladder 'buy a lot', system agrees, PEG ~1, profits expected +36% next year and forecasts raised since July despite stock -31% since mid-July. Condition: wait until after Oct 28 earnings, then DCA in a little at a time, keep position small while trend has not turned. Softens his prior BUY.
calls.base_case: Analyst forecasts raised since July; EPS +60% last quarter, full-year outlook raised.
calls.bull_case: New 2027 Nvidia rack power design lines Vertiv up for an upgrade cycle; gear due end of this year.
calls.bear_case: Sales light last quarter on delayed giant projects; pricey acquisitions; most rate-sensitive name on the list.

calls.thesis: Picks-and-shovels data-center cooling; ~23% global share (2x nearest rival), backlog +77% YoY.
